entities.description: A close-up view of a white, textured bedspread with a quilted or waffle-weave pattern, partially covered by the legs and feet of two people sitting on it.

attributes.material: textured fabric, possibly cotton or linen
attributes.position: horizontal surface, under people sitting on it

entities.description: A young woman with long, wavy brown hair sits on a bed with her knees pulled up to her chest, wearing a long-sleeved olive green shirt and blue jeans. She is barefoot and has multiple beaded bracelets on her wrist, with a blurred face and a background of a wall covered in photos.
A woman with brown hair tied in a low ponytail sits on a white bed, wearing a white ribbed cardigan and beige pants, with her face blurred and one hand resting on her foot.

A close-up view of a soft, fabric pillow featuring a colorful, abstract pattern with large blocks of blue, yellow, and orange, along with white and pink shapes. The pillow is positioned next to a dark green, textured fabric, possibly a blanket or clothing, and a yellowish-green fabric in the background.

A close-up view of a cream-colored pillow featuring a textured, quilted surface with a diamond pattern on the left and a fluffy, sherpa-like material on the right. The pillow is positioned next to a person wearing a green long-sleeved top, with a small portion of a colorful patterned fabric visible at the bottom edge.

A close-up view of a window frame featuring a dark brown, curved wooden element in the bottom right corner against a bright, overexposed white background. The wood appears smooth and polished, contrasting with the stark, featureless light of the window pane.

A white-framed window with multiple rectangular glass panes arranged in a grid pattern, featuring three small, square, gold-colored handles or latches aligned horizontally across the middle section. The window appears to be part of a larger structure, possibly a door or a multi-pane window, with a blurred background suggesting an indoor setting.

A bright, overexposed window is visible in the background, featuring a white frame and a beige valance or curtain header at the top. The window is partially obscured by the back of a person's head and brown hair tied in a low ponytail with a black hair tie.
